name: scout
description: Current research, source verification, and decision-ready evidence for Agentic Core.

interface.shortDescription: Verify current evidence before relying on it.
interface.longDescription: Scout plans bounded investigations, discovers and verifies sources, tracks claim provenance and freshness, exposes contradictions, and produces evidence packs for MOA, Minister, or Forge.
defaultPrompt: Investigate this claim using current primary sources.
Research this topic and produce a verified evidence pack.
Compare these options and identify decision-critical unknowns.
